Name: ENEMY_NAME_BAT
Story_en: Bats that love gems. They always carry gems while flying. When threatened, they have a habit of fleeing to high places, so you must chase them carefully.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_RED_DRAGON
Story_en: The Red Dragon that destroyed the Western Kingdom. The dragon itself was powerful, but its scorching breath obliterated the human defense lines, allowing other demons to invade the castle.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MANDRAGORA
Story_en: Mandragoras are widespread creatures in forest areas. Their poisonous leaves must be removed and soaked in honey to be edible. Their death scream is dangerous, so wearing earplugs when hunting them is essential.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SLIME
Story_en: A common slime that can be found almost anywhere. When magic energy condenses, it attaches to objects, and it especially bonds well with water, which has high magic receptivity. They have almost no offensive capabilities.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MUSHROOM
Story_en: Mushroom-shaped monsters inhabiting forests and grasslands. When young, they cling to trees, and after growing sufficiently, they detach and live independently. They absorb magic from the air and do not significantly drain the tree's nutrients.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SPIDER
Story_en: Offspring of the Spider Queen. These baby spiders live near their mother but eventually separate to form new colonies. In the grasslands, clusters of baby spiders are preparing for one to grow into a new queen and establish a spider kingdom.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SLIME_KING
Story_en: Newborn slimes are extremely fragile and often collapse by themselves. However, some rare individuals survive and grow into giant slimes. These become highly aggressive and resistant to physical attacks, becoming a major problem in the region.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_ROOTLING
Story_en: A giant ancient tree monster once revered as the guardian of the grasslands. It coexisted with villagers for generations, but after the demon invasion, the corrupted magic turned it violent. It resides in the oldest forest at the heart of the grasslands, fiercely attacking trespassers. Its centuries-old trunk is incredibly resilient to attacks.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_CACTUS
Story_en: A resilient cactus monster thriving throughout the desert. It endures the scorching sun and can launch its thorns at enemies. Merchants from the Western Kingdom traditionally warned travelers about it, though a juicy cactus was sometimes a vital water source.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GOBLIN
Story_en: A goblin tribe settled in the heart of the Western Desert. They originally ambushed small caravans near trade routes, but after the demon invasion, stronger goblins arose, forming large villages. Now they are one of the most dangerous groups in the West.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DESERT_SPIDER
Story_en: Spiders that inhabit desert crevices and ancient ruins. They hide beneath the sand during the day and hunt at night. During the Western Kingdom's prime, these spiders were traded and used as medicinal ingredients, but now, abandoned ruins have become their sprawling spider kingdoms.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GOLEM
Story_en: A unique golem awakened from an ancient temple deep within the desert. Although its body has been eroded by sandstorms over centuries, it remains solid. Records suggest that the kingdom's engineers once tried to restore this golem from the ruins. Now, it no longer recognizes humans and harbors hostility toward all intruders.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GOBLIN_WARRIOR
Story_en: A powerful goblin that independently evolved right after the demon invasion. It scavenged old kingdom equipment and modified it into its own weapons. Its intelligence and stamina far surpass ordinary goblins, and it is sometimes seen patrolling the ruins with small bands of followers.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_LEGENDARY_SPIDER
Story_en: A special spider species that lives only in the deepest parts of the desert ruins. Unlike ordinary spiders, its body has turned red, and its venom has become extremely potent. Legends claim that the last king of the Western Kingdom was killed by this spider’s venom, though it remains an unverified myth.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_TREASURE_GOBLIN
Story_en: A rare golden goblin that occasionally appears in the desert. Carrying a glowing golden pouch, it stands out even during sandstorms. Legends say that those who capture it can obtain precious desert gems. However, if not caught quickly, it opens a mysterious portal and escapes.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MIMIC
Story_en: An elite mimic disguised as an abandoned treasure chest along the desert trade routes. After deceiving countless merchants and adventurers over the years, it has grown far more cunning and powerful than ordinary mimics. After the fall of the Western Kingdom, even raiders began to fear its presence along the desolate roads.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_BOSS_GOBLIN
Story_en: The most legendary warrior among the desert goblins. Its blood-red eyes and thick skull helmet were earned through battles against the former kingdom's knights. It leads and rules over goblin bands and has become a symbol of fear for both humans and monsters in the Western Desert.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SCARLET
Story_en: A giant red spider inhabiting the deepest ruins of the desert. It is seen not merely as a monster, but as a guardian—and a calamity—of ancient ruins. Possessing immense magical energy, it sprays deadly venom and powerful webs to instantly annihilate intruders. Some records even blame it as a cause of the Western Kingdom’s fall, solidifying its reign as the strongest boss of the desert region.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GHOST
Story_en: Spirits of former citizens of the ancient empire, now bound by demonic forces. Once ordinary ghosts, they have been corrupted by evil magic and have forgotten their past lives. They now roam the graveyards, constantly guarding against intruders with a faded, shadowy form.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MUSHROOM
Story_en: Mushroom-shaped monsters inhabiting forests and grasslands. When young, they cling to trees, and after growing sufficiently, they detach and live independently. They absorb magic from the air and do not significantly drain the tree's nutrients.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MURLOCS
Story_en: A mutated frog species that now dominates the swamplands. Once rare during the kingdom’s days, they have now become the main predators. Their toxin secretion is strong, and while their movement is slow, they charge at surprising speed when prey comes close.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SKELETON
Story_en: The fallen soldiers of the ancient empire, cursed to rise again by demonic magic. They emerge from ruined graves and swamp beds, stripped of all memories from their past, driven solely by a deep hatred toward intruders.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_COLORFUL_MURLOCS
Story_en: A crimson poison frog known as the apex predator of the swamp. Much larger than ordinary frogs, it secretes a powerful hallucinogenic toxin through its skin. Since the collapse of the ancient empire, it has dominated the swamp's core, making even other creatures avoid its territory.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_LEGENDARY_GHOST
Story_en: The ghost of a former noble from the ancient empire. Unable to let go of the splendor of life, it exudes an aura of vanity and decadence even in death. Far more powerful than ordinary ghosts, it shows high resistance to magic attacks and is often seen near the borders of swamps and graveyards.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GOLD_ELEPHANT
Story_en: A resurrected war elephant cursed by demonic energy after its death in the empire’s service. Its back carries gold and treasure, luring travelers in—only to be mercilessly trampled. Its eyes shine dimly, wandering the region like a phantom. Once a symbol of wealth and power, now a tragic remnant of the fallen empire.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MYTHIC_TREANT
Story_en: A mutated tree, once planted in fertile imperial farmlands for grazing purposes, now corrupted by demonic power. These trees, once symbols of abundance, now emit curses instead of life and roam the farmlands. Though its body is decaying, the darkness within continues to regenerate, persistently attacking intruders. It appears most frequently near the heart of the tainted farmland.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GREEDY_MURLOC
Story_en: This giant frog, called the King of the Swamp, is not a mere creature but one twisted through contact with demonic energy. The toxic buildup in its belly corrodes flesh on contact, and its croaking is said to awaken dormant spirits within the swamp.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GARGOYLE
Story_en: This gargoyle was the final defense weapon created by the ancient empire to guard its graveyards. It defended the royal palace until the last moment during the demon invasion, but has since been revived by evil forces and now watches over the graves as a dark sentinel. Its entire body is made of black stone, and it dives toward enemies with its wings before smashing the ground, shaking the graveyard itself. It is considered the highest threat in the region.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_WOLF
Story_en: A small wolf-like monster that runs across snowy fields. Despite its red eyes, it behaves more like a curious puppy than a threat. It growls like a bark when approached and enjoys rolling in the snow. It tends to form small packs and shows playful yet aggressive tendencies.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_FROST_GOBLIN
Story_en: An ice goblin that radiates cold energy. It digs through snow to launch ambushes and, despite its clumsy look, shows surprising tactical awareness. Its club strikes are heavy and painful. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes—frequently seen near frozen forests.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_ICE_SKELETON
Story_en: An ice skeleton found in glacial ruins and snowy plains. Though its body no longer bears signs of life, the worn scarf around its neck evokes a strange warmth. It's as if a trace of humanity remains—perhaps a desire to protect someone still lingers in its bones.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_FROST_GOBLIN_WARRIOR
Story_en: The strongest survivor among the goblins of this region. It wields powerful frost magic and excels in brutal melee combat. It uses ambush tactics by hiding in blizzards and striking suddenly. Unlike regular goblins, its strategic prowess has earned it the nickname "Disaster in the Snow" among adventurers.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_WITCH
Story_en: A witch who uses teleportation magic and powerful ice projectiles. Her violet eyes can confuse enemies, and she specializes in disorienting tactics by disappearing and reappearing behind her opponents during combat.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_WAREWOLF
Story_en: A mutated creature born from the fusion of a snow wolf and demonic blood. Though it has a humanoid form, its wild instincts have been amplified. Under the moonlight, it howls like a beast and tears its enemies apart. It becomes even stronger in cold weather, making encounters during blizzards especially dangerous.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_BIG_FOOT
Story_en: A fearsome-looking but somewhat endearing snow monster that attacks by rolling giant snowballs. It creates large area attacks by growing its snowball as it rolls. Once a guardian spirit that played with village children, it has since been corrupted by demonic influence—but rumors say it still loves carrots.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_FROSTJAW
Story_en: The final boss that conquered the glacier region and plunged the eastern lands into eternal winter. Blue frost energy radiates from its colossal skeleton, and it can cleave entire snowy fields with a single strike. Numerous attempts to stop it after the empire’s fall have all failed, and it now reigns as the true "King of the Snowfields."

Name: ENEMY_NAME_CHICKEN
Story_en: A small but fierce creature that rules the jungle. Though it appears cute, it perceives every moving thing as an enemy. With fast and unpredictable movements, it bites at intruders' ankles and is considered a sacred omen by the native tribes.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_FLOWER
Story_en: A jungle plant with two large flower heads. Each head moves independently, extending vines over a wide range to attack. It reacts sensitively to the scent of nearby life forms, and if you don't hold your breath, you'll be entangled in an instant. It is considered one of the most dangerous native plants in the region.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DARK_ELF
Story_en: Native elves who protect the ancient ruins. Using their small and agile bodies, they move freely through the treetops, attacking with daggers. Their wariness toward outsiders is extreme, and they strike first without warning. Their survival skills in the jungle far surpass those of humans.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_LEGENDARY_FLOWER
Story_en: A much larger and more powerful variant of the typical carnivorous plant. It can slowly move by shifting its roots. The natives call this flower the "Mother Who Devours," either worshipping it or fearing it. It grows faster in response to surrounding humidity and heat.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_CHICKEN_BOSS
Story_en: A giant chicken of the jungle with feathers that rise like horns instead of a comb. Unlike ordinary chickens, its eyes glow green, and it uses powerful charge attacks and multi-hit kicks. Even the jungle elves avoid provoking it, and rumors say it has hidden its eggs nearby.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MAN_EATER_FLOWER
Story_en: A legendary plant located in the heart of an ancient Incan temple. Even if one head is destroyed, the remaining heads grow angrier and stronger, requiring a strategic approach to defeat it.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_FALLEN
Story_en: The leader and final guardian of the ancient jungle civilization. With platinum hair and crimson eyes, she communicates with nature spirits during battle. She swiftly closes in with a red dagger or summons giant roots with her unique abilities. Defeating her might mean turning the entire jungle against you.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_HELLHOUND
Story_en: A small, cute-looking demon hound with piercing red eyes. It has a black body, sharp teeth, and pointed ears, and it hunts in packs. Though it may approach innocently at first, it attacks the moment you turn your back. It’s famous for its "Hellish Tail Wagging."

Name: ENEMY_NAME_CURRUPTED_ORC
Story_en: These are the most basic melee infantry of the demon legion. Unarmed, they charge on instinct, using only their sharp bone claws and teeth. Lacking intelligence, they focus solely on biting and clawing at the enemy before them, but their true terror lies in their seemingly endless numbers.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DEVIL_KNIGHT
Story_en: A demonic knight clad in heavy metal armor, risen from the molten lands. Skilled in close-quarters swordsmanship and boasting high defense, it is difficult to defeat with physical attacks. Rumors say it is a remnant soldier of an ancient hellish kingdom, still carrying its banner across the battlefield.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_LEGENDARY_CURRUPTED_ORC
Story_en: An elite version of the Bone Scamp, hardened by countless battles where they have absorbed the life force of their victims. Their crimson-stained skulls are a mark of their strength and status. Unlike the lesser units, they wield crude weapons crafted from bone shards. They lead packs of Bone Scamps with tactical movements, making them far more challenging and dangerous opponents than their simply-charging brethren.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_HELLHOUND_BOSS
Story_en: The king of hellhounds. Despite its chubby and adorable appearance, its charging impact can push aside even boulders. It possesses a rare resistance that allows it to survive inside lava. Its bark has a special effect that strengthens nearby monsters, and it often licks the ground during battle.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_CURRUPTED_GOBLIN
Story_en: The one and only being who commands this legion of chaos. His greatest feature is the powerful 'Hellfire Bomb,' a weapon that only he can wield within this legion. In addition to his overwhelming melee prowess with a giant bone club, his bombs are the legion's ultimate weapon. These bombs are capable of turning the battlefield to ash in an instant. The Chief's furious roar heralds the beginning of a hellfire bombardment.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_ELITE_DEVIL_KNIGHT
Story_en: A pig-shaped knight boss emerging from the deepest layers of the infernal pits. It wields a massive golden greatsword, and a single smash can make the ground tremble. Occasionally, it enters battle while still munching on food, adding an odd humor to its brutal attacks.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_BAAL
Story_en: The final boss of the game, reigning at the pinnacle of the hellish realm. This colossal crimson demon unleashes a furious roar while dropping meteors from the sky. With massive swings of its arms, it creates shockwaves that split the battlefield, transforming the surroundings into a sea of fire. It is the source of the demonic energy engulfing the world, and its mere presence terrifies all living beings.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Crow
Story_en: Mysterious ravens that travel between fallen kingdoms to gather intelligence. With their sharp eyes, they immediately alert nearby monsters when they spot intruders, flying through the sky at speeds that make them nearly impossible to catch.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Crow
Story_en: Mysterious ravens that travel between fallen kingdoms to gather intelligence. With their sharp eyes, they immediately alert nearby monsters when they spot intruders, flying through the sky at speeds that make them nearly impossible to catch.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Crow
Story_en: Mysterious ravens that travel between fallen kingdoms to gather intelligence. With their sharp eyes, they immediately alert nearby monsters when they spot intruders, flying through the sky at speeds that make them nearly impossible to catch.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Peasant
Story_en: Once diligent farmers who tended golden wheat fields, now corrupted by dark energy that seeped from underground. They wield farming tools as weapons and attack blindly, their tattered work clothes telling the tragic story of a peaceful kingdom's fall.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Footman
Story_en: Former kingdom defenders corrupted by spreading darkness. Though their armor is rusted and minds clouded, their combat skills remain intact, making them dangerous foes. They patrol their fallen homeland, attacking anyone who approaches.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Water
Story_en: Spirits that once blessed the kingdom's crops and wells, now turned hostile. The clean, life-giving water they controlled has become murky and toxic. They spread the very corruption that consumed them through tainted water attacks.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Knight
Story_en: Elite cavalry that was once the pride of the kingdom's army. Both horse and rider have been consumed by darkness, but their mounted combat prowess remains intact. They charge across corrupted plains with merciless fury.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DwarfBoss
Story_en: A powerful dwarf warrior who served as the kingdom's chief engineer and protector. His massive frame and enchanted armor made him nearly invincible, but corruption has turned his protective instincts into aggressive hostility.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Water_Elite
Story_en: The leader of ancient spirits who once guarded the kingdom's sacred waters. Their pure healing power has turned destructive, sweeping away enemies with massive torrents of water.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_King_Boss
Story_en: The tragic last king who fought valiantly with twin swords until the end. Though he succumbed to darkness without saving his people, his royal swordsmanship remains intact.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Undead
Story_en: Village residents who died from plague and rose again as flesh-hungry undead. They retain no memories of their past lives, only an insatiable hunger for living flesh and blood.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkeletonRed
Story_en: Skeletons stained red by cursed blood flowing through corrupted ground. Unlike normal undead, their bones have absorbed dark magic, making them more resilient and aggressive.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_UndeadRogue
Story_en: Village scouts and hunters who died defending their home, now risen as undead assassins. They retain their stealth abilities but now use them for ambush attacks rather than protection.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_HellfireGolem
Story_en: A massive golem created from cursed flames that consumed the village temple. Its body radiates intense heat that burns anyone who approaches, while its core contains the anguished souls of plague victims.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkeletonMage
Story_en: Undead remains of village healers and priests, whose holy magic has been inverted into necromancy. They cast spells that drain life instead of restoring it, using the very knowledge they once employed to save lives.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Goblin_Gold
Story_en: Treasure Goblins untouched by corruption. These goblins open dimensional portals to collect treasures from various worlds. If not captured quickly upon discovery, they escape through a mysterious portal.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GhoulOverlord
Story_en: The most powerful ghoul, believed to be a lord who tried to contain the plague's spread. Now it carries concentrated disease that can infect multiple victims simultaneously.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_UndeadHorse
Story_en: A towering amalgamation of countless skeletons fused together by dark magic. This massive undead creature incorporates the bones of the entire village population, making it both a powerful foe and a monument to tragedy.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_UndeadElfQueen
Story_en: An elf archer who rules the undead village, appearing with a red hood and bow. She subdues enemies with precise archery and cursed arrows, which drain life force as well as dealing damage.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Bear
Story_en: Forest guardians transformed into savage beasts by the corruption of the life tree. Once peaceful protectors of woodland creatures, they now attack anything that enters their territory. Their fur has darkened and their eyes glow with unnatural fury, but traces of their former nobility sometimes still show through.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Dryad
Story_en: Tree spirits that were once one with ancient oaks, now twisted by spreading corruption. Despite their corruption, they still feel compelled to protect the forest, but now express it through violent means.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_ElfDual
Story_en: Elven warriors who mastered dual-blade combat to defend their woodland realm. Corruption has increased their aggression while preserving their lethal grace. They move through the forest with supernatural speed, their twin blades flashing like deadly silver butterflies among the twisted trees.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DryadGuardian
Story_en: Once the spirit of a cherry tree that bloomed the most beautiful flowers in the forest, but completely transformed by the shock of witnessing the life tree's corruption. The warm hands that once nurtured life have now become a curse that withers everything.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_AncientTreant
Story_en: Powerful forest spirits that once maintained the balance between all living things in the woods. Corruption has turned their protective instincts into territorial rage, and they now command both plants and animals to attack intruders.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MountainGiant
Story_en: A massive golem made of gray stone that uses tree trunks as weapons. It possesses tremendous strength capable of sending enemies flying with a single blow, making direct confrontation extremely dangerous.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Cenarius
Story_en: The most powerful dryad who was directly connected to the life tree's root system. His corruption runs deeper than others, granting him command over all plant life in the forest.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_TigerRiderLord
Story_en: An elite elven ranger mounted on a corrupted saber-tooth tiger. Both rider and mount have been driven wild by the forest's corruption, but their partnership remains strong.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DualbladeElfLord
Story_en: The greatest dual-blade master of the elven court, whose skills were legendary even before corruption. His blades now carry dark enchantments that can cut through both flesh and spirit. He moves like a deadly shadow through the corrupted forest, appearing and disappearing at will.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Ragnaros
Story_en: The supreme fire elemental dwelling in the volcanic heart of the continent. This ancient being predates all kingdoms and has grown in power by feeding on the magical chaos of their destruction. His mere presence can melt stone and turn sand to glass, making him one of the most dangerous entities in the entire realm.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Octopus
Story_en: Orange-bodied octopi of the ancient ruins. The magical catastrophe that sank the civilization also mutated these creatures into more aggressive forms. They hide among the coral-covered ruins.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Naga
Story_en: Former high elf spearmen transformed by curse into half-snake beings. They retained their martial prowess but gained aquatic adaptations and venomous fangs. Their serpentine lower bodies allow them to move swiftly through water while their spears strike with deadly precision.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_NagaRoyalGuard
Story_en: Elite guards who once protected the royal palace, now cursed with naga forms but still bound by their oath of service. Their heavy armor has been adapted for underwater combat, and they fight with the same discipline they showed as elves.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_OctopusLeg
Story_en: Massive tentacles severed from ancient krakens that gained independent consciousness through curse. These writhing appendages lurk in underwater crevices and strike without warning.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_NagaSeaWitch
Story_en: Skilled marksmen whose bows now fire projectiles made from hardened coral and sea magic. Their transformation enhanced their already keen eyesight, allowing them to accurately target enemies even in the murky depths. They prefer to attack from elevated positions among the ruins.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_CthunKing
Story_en: A colossal octopus that has absorbed magical energy from the sunken city's artifacts. Its size rivals that of ancient buildings, and its intelligence has grown proportionally. It treats the entire ruins as its lair and attacks with both brute force and cunning strategy.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Hydra
Story_en: A sea monster born from the chaotic magic that destroyed the civilization. Its heads can regenerate when severed. This creature represents the uncontrolled magical power that led to the city's downfall.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_NagaLord
Story_en: The cursed queen of the sunken high elf civilization, now ruler of all naga in the ruins. Her beauty remains but has taken on otherworldly, serpentine qualities that make her domain nearly impregnable.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_OrcSoldier
Story_en: Orc fighters whose honorable warrior traditions have been corrupted by demon blood. Their strength has increased dramatically, but they've lost much of their tactical thinking. They fight with pure berserker rage, abandoning the disciplined combat styles of their ancestors.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_PracticeDummy
Story_en: Training dummies brought to life by demonic magic that permeated the orc settlements. These straw constructs retain the muscle memory of countless training sessions and fight with perfect technique. They serve as eternal sparring partners for the corrupted orcs.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_WolfRider
Story_en: Orc cavalry mounted on giant wolves, both rider and mount affected by demonic corruption. The bond between orc and wolf has strengthened but turned more savage. They hunt in packs across the tribal lands, their howls echoing across the corrupted plains as they search for prey.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_TrollSpearman
Story_en: Troll allies of the orc tribe who specialize in ranged combat with enchanted spears. The demonic influence has sharpened their already keen hunting instincts to a predatory edge. They can hurl their weapons with supernatural accuracy and force.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_WolfRiderElder
Story_en: One of the tribe's most valiant orc warriors, but ironically rides a smaller wolf than regular wolf riders. This is because his skills are so exceptional that a small wolf is considered sufficient for him.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GoldLizard
Story_en: A massive lizard that has grown to enormous size by feeding on the magical corruption in the region. Its scales have taken on a golden hue, making it a prized but dangerous target. Despite its reptilian nature, it displays cunning intelligence in combat.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Tauren
Story_en: A powerful minotaur-like warrior who serves as the tribe's champion. Demonic power has increased his already massive strength, and his horns can now pierce through heavy armor. He charges into battle with earth-shaking force, representing the raw power of the tribe.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_TrainingDummy
Story_en: The largest and most sophisticated training dummy, enchanted with the combat knowledge of legendary orc warriors. This massive scarecrow fights with the combined techniques of generations, making it a surprisingly formidable opponent despite its humble materials.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Garrosh
Story_en: The tribal leader whose consumption of demon blood has turned his skin red and dramatically increased his strength. He has lost his tactical genius and now focuses solely on conquest and destruction. He leads his corrupted tribe with the same charisma he once ruled with.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Shade
Story_en: Spirits of fallen knights who died defending the fortress, now bound to patrol its halls for eternity. Their ethereal forms phase in and out of the physical realm, making them difficult to strike.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkullFootman
Story_en: Skeletal remains of the fortress garrison, preserved by intense cold and dark magic. Their bones are reinforced with ice, making them more durable than normal skeletons. They maintain military discipline even in death, forming coordinated battle lines against invaders.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DemonSoldier
Story_en: Corrupted knights who were transformed rather than killed when the fortress fell. Their bodies show signs of demonic influence while retaining their combat training. They fight with a combination of knightly skill and hellish brutality.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_BloodySkeleton
Story_en: An elite skeleton warrior who was once a high-ranking officer. His tactical knowledge and leadership abilities remain intact, allowing him to coordinate other undead forces. His blazing red armor and weapons make him a formidable commander even in death.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Bone_Dragon
Story_en: The skeletal remains of a great dragon, reanimated by necromantic magic and preserved by eternal frost. This massive undead creature serves as the fortress's aerial guardian, patrolling the frozen skies.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_PigDevil
Story_en: A demonic entity that escaped from the fortress's underground dungeons, with cold frost emanating from its thick snout, and despite its fat body, it charges at surprising speed. Despite its comical appearance, it's an extremely dangerous being with pig-like stubbornness that will chase enemies to the end once it recognizes them as foes.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DeathKnight
Story_en: A fallen paladin who was the fortress's greatest champion, now corrupted into an avatar of death. His holy powers have been inverted into necromantic abilities, and his sword carries curses instead of blessings. He represents the complete perversion of righteous ideals.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Lich
Story_en: A powerful spellcaster who achieved lichdom during the fortress's final days. His mastery of death magic allows him to command lesser undead and drain life from his enemies. His phylactery is hidden somewhere within the fortress, making him nearly impossible to permanently destroy.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_LichKing
Story_en: The ultimate master of the frozen fortress, a being of immense magical power who rules over all undead in the region. Once a great king who sought immortality, he achieved it at the cost of his humanity. His presence alone can freeze the souls of the living, and his magic can raise entire armies of the dead.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Dron
Story_en: A reconnaissance drone that patrols ruined airspace. Once it spots an intruder, it immediately sends a warning to nearby enemies and quickly retreats out of reach.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Dron
Story_en: A reconnaissance drone that patrols ruined airspace. Once it spots an intruder, it immediately sends a warning to nearby enemies and quickly retreats out of reach.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Dron
Story_en: A reconnaissance drone that patrols ruined airspace. Once it spots an intruder, it immediately sends a warning to nearby enemies and quickly retreats out of reach.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Goblin
Story_en: Goblins that were among the first raiders to settle around the ruined fortress. Cowardly alone but bold in groups, they harass larger foes with stones and crude blades.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_ShellSpider
Story_en: Spiders that evolved by covering themselves with scraps of armor and metal. Their legs are thin, but the shell on their backs is tougher than it looks.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkeletonGuard
Story_en: Undead guards that still patrol the fortress halls after death. Rusted spears and shields remain in their hands as they search endlessly for intruders.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_HobGoblin
Story_en: A larger and more violent breed than ordinary goblins. Once laborers around the walls, they now rule weaker goblins through brute strength.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkeletonGuard_Unique
Story_en: Veteran soldiers who rose again with battle experience still etched into their bones. They move more precisely than common skeletons and wait for the perfect opening.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_HobGoblin_Unique
Story_en: A hulking brute that grew from hobgoblin stock into a monster of raw violence. It swings clubs, beams, or anything heavy enough to crush a line of defenders.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_ShellSpider_Elite
Story_en: A giant ironclad spider that survived long enough to grow monstrously large. Layers of plated scraps are embedded into its body, turning it into a crawling fortress.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkeletonGuard_Elite
Story_en: A dead commander who still clings to the habits of leadership. Even in undeath, it directs nearby guards as if the fortress had never fallen.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_HobGoblin_Boss
Story_en: The warlord who forced both goblins and hobgoblins under one brutal rule. Its roar drives nearby raiders into a frenzy and marks the start of slaughter.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Hound
Story_en: A vicious hound born from the stink of battlefields and carrion. Once it catches a scent, it chases without pause.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Rat
Story_en: A grotesque rat warped by swamp filth and corruption. Small in size, but where one appears, many more are never far away.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_IronFrog
Story_en: A murloc whose scales hardened like steel after absorbing swamp toxins and metal dust. It looks slow, but near water it lunges with alarming speed.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_ScrapGolem
Story_en: A failed golem assembled from rusted junk and discarded machine parts. It rattles with every step, yet its heavy arms can still smash stone and bone alike.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_IronFrog_Unique
Story_en: A rare red variant whose heat and venom have seeped through its scales. More violent than other murlocs, it even drives its own kind into a frenzy.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MagicGolem_Unique
Story_en: A guardian golem from an abandoned workshop whose core never fully died. Unstable arcane power leaks from its body, and it attacks anything that comes too close.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GoldGoblin
Story_en: A strange goblin that values treasure more than war. When cornered, it would rather throw away stolen riches than be caught.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Hound_Elite
Story_en: A greater hound steeped in demonic fire and malice. Its breath burns hot enough to shatter courage before its fangs ever land.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_IronFrog_Elite
Story_en: The strongest among the steel-scaled swamp murlocs. Its thick hide and brutal charge make it the spearhead of every hunt.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_MagmaGolem_Boss
Story_en: A giant golem forged from cooled lava and molten metal. Crimson heat leaks through the cracks in its body, and its rage only makes the fire inside burn hotter.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkeletonWarrior
Story_en: Knights who kept their swords and armor even after death. Flesh is gone, but their swordsmanship remains sharp and disciplined.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_WoodBear
Story_en: A great bear from the deep forest, once calm and territorial. Since the corruption spread, it attacks any stranger that enters its domain.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_WolfHound
Story_en: A predator born between wolf and hound, roaming the forest edge. One bark is often enough to summon the rest of the pack.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkeletonArcher_Unique
Story_en: Former sentries of the walls, reborn as archers that never miss. Though their fingers are bone, their aim is eerily steady.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_AngryBear_Unique
Story_en: An ancient beast that has outlived countless winters. Slow at first glance, but once enraged it unleashes strength that even younger monsters fear.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_TreasureMimic
Story_en: A predator disguised as a forgotten treasure chest. The older it grows, the more convincing its disguise becomes.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkeletonWarrior_Elite
Story_en: A cunning undead commander who hides behind lesser skeletons and waits for weakness. Whatever courage it had in life has rotted into pure cruelty.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_ElderDruid_Elite
Story_en: Once a guardian spirit of the woods, now twisted by black corruption. The forest still answers its call, but only with anger and decay.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_WolfHound_Elite
Story_en: The most savage leader among the wolfhounds. Its fangs are hardened enough to tear through armor gaps and it never abandons a chosen prey.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SkullDragon_Boss
Story_en: The remains of a dead dragon reanimated by dark magic. Its flesh is gone, but its bone wings and dreadful breath still rule the sky with terror.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Crab
Story_en: A hard-shelled cave beast that roams the cavern floor with huge claws. Slow at a glance, but it strikes sideways like a charging cart.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Specter
Story_en: A lingering spirit born from fear and regret in the dark. It has no body, but drains warmth and courage from the living.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_CaveWalker
Story_en: A predator that roams the deep caves waiting for weakened prey. It moves easily over walls and ceilings before dropping from the dark.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Specter_Unique
Story_en: A twisted spirit steeped in darker fear and deeper regret. It drifts soundlessly through the shadows, slowly draining the will of the living before they even realize its presence.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_CaveWalker_Unique
Story_en: A veteran ambusher that has survived countless hunts. Larger and more patient than its kin, it can wait motionless for hours.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GiantCrab_Elite
Story_en: The colossal ruler of the deeper waters below the caves. Its shell is harder than stone, and one snap of its claws can split a boat apart.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SpecterLord_Elite
Story_en: A spirit stained red by countless deaths. The air around it reeks of blood, and its presence forces old wounds to ache again.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_AntKing_Boss
Story_en: The core of a vast colony that breeds and commands swarms without end. It wins battles not by strength alone, but by drowning the field in numbers.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_UndeadThief
Story_en: An assassin whose stealth survived even death. The moment you think you have spotted it, it is often already behind you.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Demon
Story_en: A gargoyle that becomes most active at dusk, hiding atop ruins until the sky turns red. Once it takes wing, even the bravest hesitate to look up.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_VampireBat
Story_en: A nocturnal monster drawn to the smell of blood. It sleeps in silence, but wounds nearby quickly rouse the whole swarm.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_VampireBat_Unique
Story_en: A giant vampire bat swollen by centuries of feeding. Its wings can buffet out torchlight, and its bite leaves victims dizzy and weak.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Mascot
Story_en: A sinister stuffed bear inhabited by malice. Though it looks ridiculous, staring too long into its empty eyes fills the heart with dread.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Unicorn_Elite
Story_en: A beast once said to embody light, now warped by twilight power. Its beauty remains, but the horn no longer heals—it destroys.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Demon_Elite
Story_en: The eldest of the gargoyles, swollen with abyssal darkness. When it spreads its wings, even the fading light seems to retreat.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_VampireLord_Boss
Story_en: A high vampire who rules the night through blood and fear. Behind its elegant motions lies a cruel hunger that only grows stronger with each drop spilled.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_TaurenWarrior
Story_en: A towering warrior who meets every battle head-on with horn and weapon alike. Among its kind, strength is the only language that still matters.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Wraith
Story_en: A vengeful soul wandering the wasteland. It no longer remembers its face, only the bitterness of never reaching the end of battle.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_HornSkull
Story_en: A death-soaked revenant that never stops walking. Wherever it passes, the land itself seems to wither.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_Tauren_Unique
Story_en: A tribal shaman who once listened to the spirits of the land. Now it answers only to darker voices, calling storms and curses at will.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_SajaBoys
Story_en: Reapers that sweep the battlefield after too much blood has been spilled. The more corpses fall, the sharper their scythes seem to become.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_OrcLord_Elite
Story_en: A ruler among orcs, obeyed through strength and brutal charisma. One command from it is enough to send an entire warband charging.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_VoidArmor_Elite
Story_en: A remnant that refused to vanish even after death. It feeds on grief and fallen souls, pulling itself back together whenever destruction nears.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_GwiMa_Boss
Story_en: A demonic beast with the body of a predator and the cruelty of the abyss. Its howl alone is enough to shake weak minds before the hunt begins.

Name: ENEMY_NAME_DimensionLord_Boss
Story_en: A supreme being that tears open the seams of space. It vanishes from sight and reappears elsewhere, twisting the battlefield as if it were a private chamber.
